history.content: Why am I getting a "method not allowed" error?

The "method not allowed" 405 error is returned when you use an unsupported HTTP request type with a URL that doesn't support the specified type. This is common when the client doesn't support the use of HTTP methods and POST is used instead with the X-HTTP-Method-Override request header set to the actual HTTP method.
Where can I find this documentation?
Regarding 405 error code, you can visit https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/cloudantlist-of-http-codes.
So my guess that this was a server error is correct?
No, the "method not allowed" error occurs when the user uses an unsupported HTTP request type with a URL that doesn't support the specified type.
I get that, but can't it also be caused by an incorrect server-side configuration?
